summary: Milestone logistic-cv: run analysis.py pilot-only (nested CV, no --final), write cv_auc alone to out/metrics.json
reasoning: The pilot-only tuning (steps 13-14) fixed the design: degree-2 polynomial kernel expansion of the standardised twelve given features plus L2 logistic, lying in a flat plateau (plain 5-fold 0.8845-0.8851, honest nested 5x3 estimate 0.8852, gamma=1.0 picked in all five outer folds). analysis.py now selects among the eight plateau configurations by nested CV (outer 5-fold, inner 3-fold, all pilot-only, single thread) and, without --final, writes only cv_auc to out/metrics.json - the held-out file is never opened. This is the logistic-cv milestone run; I expect cv_auc ~= 0.885 from the tuning, comfortably >= 0.80. I build on the route's provisional kernel-logistic precedent (0.8678) which my pilot grid now exceed with a pinned-degree, edge-free design.
